parameters.note: Beardsley Reservoir is not listed in CCR §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so it falls under the general statewide lake regulation in §5.85(a)(1). (The special regulation in §7.50(b)(147) applies to the Middle Fork Stanislaus River from Beardsley Dam downstream, including the Beardsley Afterbay — a separate water below the dam, not the reservoir itself.)

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water)

schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists Beardsley Reservoir (Region 4, Tuolumne Co.) for sub-catchable-size Brown Trout under the Put and Grow program, with a stated release month range of May-November. This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant.
